The application requires one transit provider logo for display on the landing page.

The source logo file should be provided by the agency as part of their onboarding form.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The logo should be white with a clear background in the dimensions below:

> height: 64px
> width: any

- [ ] Logo file is processed by a designer and added to the DSDL library
- [ ] Processed logo file is uploaded to this ticket
